headline: Anthropic's Opus 5.5 Redefines AI Agent Architecture
summary: Anthropic has released Opus 5.5, a new version of its Claude platform that decouples AI agents' reasoning capabilities from their execution environment, signaling a shift in how AI systems are designed and deployed.
whyItMatters: This separation enhances safety and scalability, potentially setting a new standard for AI agent architecture in the industry.

primaryArticle.title: Anthropic Unveils Opus 5.5: Claude Platform with Decoupled AI Agents

supportingStories.title: Anthropic Unveils Opus 5.5: Brain and Hands Separation in LLMs for Enhanced Safety and Scalability
